# STEP 2 — `plan.md` · Space Invaders

**Working title:** *NEON INVADERS — Sector 7 Defense*
**Genre:** 3D retro-futurist arcade shooter (classic Space Invaders mechanics, AAA presentation)
**Stack:** Three.js (ESM) · Vite · hand-written physics · 100% procedural assets

---

## 1. Core Gameplay — Mathematical Model

### 1.1 Coordinate & Playfield Model
- Playfield is a **2D plane in (x, z)**; `y` is purely visual height. Camera sits at elevation ≈ 32°, looking down the field — classic side-view gameplay in a 3D perspective arena.
- Bounds: `X ∈ [−11, 11]`, `Z ∈ [−16 (invader line) , +14 (player line)]`.
- All collision is **AABB in XZ** — no rotation in gameplay space, so no SAT needed.

### 1.2 Invader Formation (the heart of the game)
- Grid: **5 rows × 11 columns = 55 invaders**. Cell pitch `DX = 1.55`, `DZ = 1.35`.
- Invader position: `x = fx + (c − 5)·DX`, `z = fz − (2 − r)·DZ` (row 0 = far/top, row 4 = near).
- **Discrete stepping** (authentic): `acc += dt · stepsPerSecond(remaining)`; while `acc ≥ 1`: `acc −= 1; fx += dir·STEP (0.62); frame = 1 − frame`.
- **Speed curve** (classic-inspired, piecewise-linear on remaining count `n`):

| remaining | 55 | 40 | 25 | 10 | 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| steps/s | 1.0 | 2.5 | 4.5 | 7.0 | 10.0 |

  `stepsPerSecond(n) = lerp over table × (1 + 0.15·(wave−1))`.
- **Edge + drop:** track live `minCol/maxCol`. If `dir>0` and `fx + (maxCol−5)·DX > 11` → `dir = −1; fz += DROP (1.1)`. Mirror for left.
- **Invasion condition:** any live invader `z ≥ 12.5` → player destroyed (game over), authentic to the original.
- **March audio is step-driven:** each step plays the next of 4 descending bass notes — tempo *is* the speed curve.

### 1.3 Invader Bombs
- Fire timer: `interval = lerp(1.9s, 0.45s, 1 − n/55) / (1 + 0.1·(wave−1))`.
- Each shot: pick a **random live invader, weighted toward the bottom row** (weights `[1,1,2,3,5]`); bomb `vz = +lerp(6, 14, 1 − n/55) + 2·(wave−1)` u/s.
- Bomb pool cap: 12 concurrent.

### 1.4 Player
- `x += axisX · 14 u/s · dt`, clamped to `[−10.4, 10.4]`.
- **Fire:** max 2 bullets on screen (classic constraint, modern feel), cooldown `0.28s`; power-ups raise to 3 / halve cooldown.
- Bullet: `vz = −34 u/s`, despawn at `z < −17`.
- **Tunneling-proof collision:** bullets are fast vs. small targets → **segment-vs-AABB slab test** (ray-AABB) from previous to current position, not point-in-box. Same test for bombs.

### 1.5 Bunkers (destructible shields)
- 4 bunkers at `x ∈ {−8.25, −2.75, 2.75, 8.25}`, `z = +8.5`.
- Each = **16×12 voxel grid**, cell `0.28` units. Silhouette mask computed analytically: dome top (`y > h·(1 − 0.55·(1 − (2x/w)²))`), notch at bottom center (`|x| < 0.22w && y < 0.3h → dead`).
- **Erosion:** a bullet segment passing through kills every live cell whose center is within `r = 0.55` of the segment (point-segment distance); bombs use `r = 0.95`. Bullet is consumed on first bunker contact (authentic).
- Render: **one InstancedMesh**, 4×192 = 768 box instances; dead cells get zero-scale matrices (dirty-flag batched update).

### 1.6 UFO (Mystery Ship)
- Spawns every `12–20s` (seeded RNG) when none active; crosses at `z = −14.5`, `v = ±8 u/s`.
- Score: weighted pick from `{50:40%, 100:25%, 150:15%, 300:12%, 500:8%}`.

### 1.7 Scoring, Combo, Lives, Waves
- Row values (top→bottom): **40 / 30 / 20 / 10 / 50** (classic squid/crab/octopus/small/big).
- **Combo (modern):** consecutive kills without a *missed* bullet (left field or hit bunker) raise multiplier `×1 → ×4` in 0.25 steps; any miss resets. Shown in HUD.
- Extra life at 1,000, then every 5,000. Hi-score persisted to `localStorage`.
- 3 lives; on hit: explosion, 2.0s respawn invulnerability (blink), continue.
- **Wave clear** → interstitial → next wave: formation starts `1.2` units lower, speed ×1.15, bomb rate ×1.1.

### 1.8 Power-ups (modern layer, 12% drop chance on kill)
`DOUBLE` (3s, 3 bullets) · `RAPID` (5s, cooldown ×0.5) · `SHIELD` (absorbs 1 hit, 8s) · `WIDE` (3s, 2.5× bullet hitbox). Fall at `2.2 u/s`; collect on overlap.

## 2. Modern Enhancements — 18 AAA Upgrades (exact Three.js implementations)

1. **3D perspective arena** — camera `(0, 13.5, 21)` → target `(0, 1.5, −2)`, `fov 55`; subtle parallax: `camera.x = lerp(camera.x, playerX·0.22, 1−e^(−6dt))`.
2. **Synthwave grid floor** — 70×90 plane, `ProceduralTextures.grid()` (512² canvas: `#05060f` base, neon cyan lines every 32px with `shadowBlur` glow, magenta major lines), `MeshStandardMaterial({ map, emissiveMap, emissive: 0x00f0ff, emissiveIntensity: 0.35, roughness: 0.9 })`, texture `repeat(14, 18)`.
3. **Retro sun** — 26-unit disc far behind the formation: canvas radial gradient (magenta→orange) with horizontal stripe cutouts (classic synthwave), emissive plane, slow hue pulse.
4. **Parallax starfield** — **InstancedMesh** of 250 tiny octahedra (strict `MeshStandardMaterial`, emissive white/cyan), 3 depth shells, slow rotation + twinkle via per-instance scale oscillation.
5. **Invaders as merged low-poly models** — 5 distinct silhouettes built from box compositions, **2 animation frames each** (leg swap), merged with `BufferGeometryUtils.mergeGeometries` → **10 InstancedMeshes total** (5 types × 2 frames), 55 instances, 10 draw calls. Frame toggle = swap which frame mesh holds the instances (all of a type animate in sync, authentic).
6. **Player ship** — merged hull geometry, cyan emissive cockpit, **engine glow** (emissive cone) + continuous **engine particle stream** from ParticleManager.
7. **Tracer bullets** — glowing capsule `InstancedMesh` (pool 8) + **MotionTrail** ribbon per active bullet (12-segment strip, vertex-colored fade, additive).
8. **Plasma bombs** — icosahedron `InstancedMesh` (pool 12), magenta emissive, trails, **shockwave ring + spark burst** on impact.
9. **Voxel bunkers** — as in §1.5; neon-green emissive cells with dark core material; cratering reads as physical destruction.
10. **UFO saucer** — lathe geometry + rotating emissive ring, siren SFX, gold trail.
11. **Bloom-tuned neon** — `UnrealBloomPass(strength 0.85, radius 0.55, threshold 0.72)` + ACES tone mapping; emissive materials glow **without washing to white** (threshold above base albedo, below emissive peaks).
12. **Trauma camera shake** — decay `trauma *= e^(−3.2·dt)`, offset `= trauma² · 0.55 · (sin/cos noise)`; impact-scaled (see §4).
13. **Hit-stop** — global timescale dilation via GameLoop (see §4).
14. **Particle bursts** — centralized manager, **hard cap 500**, 4 color-bucket `InstancedMesh`es (cyan/magenta/yellow/white), each 125 instances → ≤4 draw calls, oldest-recycled over cap.
15. **Floating score text** — pooled HTML chips (12 DOM nodes), 3D→screen projection each frame, rise + fade, glassmorphism styling, combo-colored.
16. **Combo multiplier system** — §1.7; HUD meter fills with neon gradient.
17. **Power-up drops** — §1.8; distinct emissive icons (instanced octahedra with per-type color), pickup chime.
18. **Full audio synth** — Web Audio: step-driven 4-note invader march (tempo = speed curve), laser pew, layered noise explosions, UFO siren, power-up arpeggio, wave fanfare, ambient pad; master → compressor → destination; `AudioContext` resumed on first input (autoplay policy).

## 3. Graphics Pipeline

### 3.1 Post-processing stack
```
RenderPass
  → UnrealBloomPass( strength 0.85, radius 0.55, threshold 0.72 )
  → OutputPass   (tone mapping + sRGB)
```
- `WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' })`
- `toneMapping = ACESFilmicToneMapping`, `exposure = 1.05`, `outputColorSpace = SRGBColorSpace`
- `setPixelRatio(min(devicePixelRatio, 2))`

### 3.2 Lighting (no shadow maps — performance)
- `HemisphereLight(0x2a3f66, 0x05060a, 0.9)`
- `DirectionalLight(0xbfd8ff, 1.2)` from `(6, 12, −8)`
- `PointLight(0x00f0ff, 40, 45)` at `(−13, 5, 10)` · `PointLight(0xff2bd6, 40, 45)` at `(13, 5, −12)` — cyan/magenta rim split, the retro-futurist signature.
- Fake grounding: radial-gradient blob-shadow planes under player/invaders/UFO (transparent `MeshStandardMaterial`, opacity 0.3).

### 3.3 Procedural generation math
- **Grid texture:** 512² canvas; minor lines every 32px `rgba(0,240,255,0.55)` + `shadowBlur 6`; major every 128px magenta `rgba(255,43,214,0.8)`.
- **Particle sprite:** radial gradient `#fff → color → transparent` (used only where a texture is needed; particles themselves are geometry).
- **Invader silhouettes:** box compositions per type (e.g., squid = body box + 2 head boxes + 4 leg boxes; frame B shifts legs ±0.12), merged per frame.
- **Bunker mask:** analytic dome + notch (§1.5).
- **Retro sun:** radial gradient + `clearRect` stripe bands.
- **Seeded RNG:** mulberry32 — reproducible wave layouts/spawns per seed.

### 3.4 Draw-call budget (steady state)
Floor 1 · Sun 1 · Stars 1 · Walls 2 · Invaders 10 · Bullets 1 · Bombs 1 · Bunkers 1 · UFO 1 · Player 1 · Particles ≤4 · Rings ≤3 · Trails ≤5 · Shadows ≤3 → **≈ 35–40 draw calls**. Comfortable.

## 4. VFX Implementation — Priority Logic

**Priority order (highest wins when budget/attention conflicts):**
`PLAYER_HIT > UFO_KILL > WAVE_CLEAR > INVADER_KILL > BUNKER_EROSION > BULLET_IMPACT > AMBIENT`

| Event | Hit-stop (duration @ timescale) | Shake trauma added | Particles | Other |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Player hit | 140 ms @ 0.05 | +0.65 | 60 sparks (white/cyan) + big shockwave | HUD red flash, engine cut |
| Player death (final) | 250 ms @ 0.03 | +0.9 | 90 sparks + double shockwave | slow-mo into game-over |
| UFO kill | 160 ms @ 0.08 | +0.45 | 40 gold sparks + shockwave | floating score (gold) |
| Invader kill | 45 ms @ 0.25 (only if combo ≥ 3) | +0.10 + 0.02·combo | 22 sparks (type color) + ring | floating `+N×M` text |
| Bomb hits bunker | — | +0.06 | 12 sparks | crater |
| Bullet hits bunker | — | +0.03 | 8 sparks | — |
| Power-up pickup | 60 ms @ 0.4 | +0.05 | 16 sparks (type color) | chime + HUD tag |
| Wave clear | 200 ms @ 0.1 | +0.3 | 80 sparks across formation | fanfare + interstitial |

- **Hit-stop** is a **global timescale** on the fixed-timestep accumulator (physics, particles, trails all dilate uniformly; render keeps running) — reads as *weight*, never stutter.
- **Shake** is trauma-based: `trauma = min(1, trauma + add)`, decay `e^(−3.2·dt)`, offset `trauma²·0.55` in a 2-axis pseudo-noise; applied post-parallax so it never fights the camera follow.
- **Particle budget:** manager enforces 500 hard; over-cap spawns recycle the oldest instance (ring buffer), so a wave-clear burst can never starve a later player-hit burst — priority is enforced by *size*, not by dropping.
